common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Datacentre backlash
notable.line: Coordinated physical protests and sabotage attempts against new data-centre and gigafactory sites in two or more member states, delaying grid connection and forcing a policing response.

notable.title: Datacentre siting blockade
notable.line: Coordinated physical protests and grid-connection blockades at two mediated EU data-centre sites delay construction for weeks amid low public trust and opaque-model coverage.
